# Linux DML21 reference vectors for amdgpu_dcn401_dml.rs with ODM 3:1 and 4:1;
# verify with check.sh (harness_multi.c, RAISED). Each line is
# <bytes per pixel> <DSC slices> <DSC bpp_x16> <4:2:0> then a multi_vectors.txt
# input line: every stream's plane at that depth (PIXEL_BYTES), compressed
# with those slices unless 0 (DSC), and leaving as HDMI 4:2:0 if 1 (FMT420).
# The inputs are every "! Unsupported odm" configuration of the older files
# (which predate the port's 3:1 and 4:1) and configurations around 8K, 10K,
# 5K and 4K480 streams beside others; results as multi_vectors.txt (a stream
# on n > 1 pipes ends each of its planes with "/<n>" and every further pipe's
# blank end; "! ClockState raised", "! PixelClock dfs" and "! Register" as
# format_vectors.txt). --regenerate-odm34 answers the inputs again.
